posts.body:
I was so worried about what to do with the kids when their school closed and they were stuck at home due to Covid-19, but YFA were great and really professional. Knowing that I could leave them to get on with a project for a few hours each day was such a relief, and it was both educational constructive! Would hugely recommend for any parents pulling their hair out about what to do, and its great fun for the kids! The team were super helpful and flexible to create a course around my schedule.
Young Film Academy are now offering even more Remote Private Filmmaking Courses and Masterclasses, starting from as little as £90!
All courses are for up to 4 students, ages 10-17, which take place in your home via ZOOM. Students are immersed in an engaging creative process and learn important new skills – all while making a movie!
Courses include:
Remote Private Filmmaking Courses - these are private courses which can be booked for a flexible number of sessions.
4-Day Film School - in which students learn how to make a short film in just 4 days!
Screen-Acting Studio - this is for budding actors and actresses and runs across 3 weeks.
They also have 3 hour Masterclasses for the older ones!
All the courses are led by professional filmmaker tutors with lots of experience working with young people.
For more information on all YFA's Remote Private Filmmaking Courses visit their website.
